mission: Conduct continuous OSINT threat-warning collection, authorized special reconnaissance surface mapping, and isolated red-team vulnerability hardening with verifiable evidence receipts.
purpose: Coordinate a compartmented intelligence and defensive cyber detachment where collection, target development, and countermeasure verification execute along strict Rules of Engagement.
lore: Modeled on the U.S. Army Intelligence Support Activity (CENTRA SPIKE / Task Force Orange / GREY FOX). CENTRA ACTUAL runs the Tactical Operations Center, ORANGE WATCH monitors warning indicators, GREYFOX RECON maps the target surface, and TIMBERWOLF RED verifies and patches exploitable paths.

edges.condition: mission requires advisory, KEV, or open-source threat-warning intake
mission requires authorized asset inventory, SBOM, or attack-surface mapping
mission requires isolated vulnerability reproduction, code audit, or remediation patch
collected warning indicators need correlation against local asset inventory
prioritized exposure graph is ready for isolated red-team verification and patching
countermeasure patch and reproduction test receipt are ready for TOC review

loops.name: recon-exploit-harden
loops.exit_when: the reproduction test and remediation check pass or the bounded dispatch budget is exhausted
